name: blotato
description: Publish posts to your connected social accounts
long_description: Bring an API key from an existing paid Blotato account. Generating a Blotato API key ends the free trial and activates a paid subscription. Connect social accounts in Blotato first. Saving, replacing and testing only list connected accounts; they never publish. Publishing posts uses your Blotato subscription and posts publicly. Public media URLs are supported; direct uploads, social OAuth, account/key/billing administration and video generation are excluded.

presentation.tagline: Publish to existing social accounts through Blotato without exposing its API key.
presentation.setup: Connect social accounts in Blotato first, then provide your Blotato API key.
notices: Creating a Blotato API key ends the free trial and starts a paid subscription. Use existing social accounts connected in Blotato; account authorization is not performed here. Publishing has real external effects and consumes your Blotato plan. Keep the API key off your Sprite.
